title: Tech Inject Design Library
shortDescription: A modern, highly accessible React component system and interactive design library crafted with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and direct-source component generation.
overview: Tech Inject Design Library is an enterprise-grade UI system built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Inspired by clean developer-first philosophies, it provides developers with copy-ready, animated, accessible components with zero package bloat, rich micro-interactions, and deep theme customization.
problem: Traditional npm component libraries introduce package bloat, lock projects into rigid styling abstractions, and make customizing component internals tedious and fragile.
solution: Created an interactive design library platform with a live component showcase, customizable theme tokens, responsive previews, and zero-overhead copyable source code.

features.title: Zero-Overhead Direct Source
features.description: Copy clean, modular, typed React components directly into your codebase with complete styling ownership.

features.title: Motion-Engineered Physics
features.description: Pre-configured Framer Motion spring physics, micro-interactions, and smooth layout morphing.

features.title: Complete Theme Tokenization
features.description: Semantic CSS variables supporting instant light, dark, and vibrant high-contrast color schemes.

features.title: Interactive Live Playground
features.description: Inspect component states, tweak props live, view source code, and test keyboard accessibility.

contributions: Engineered 35+ accessible UI primitives including command palettes, glowing cards, bento grids, and interactive dialogs.
Designed the full documentation showcase platform with live prop tweak controls and code copy tools.
Configured automated accessibility tests with axe-core and visual regression checks.
Standardized dark mode CSS tokens and spring animation presets.

challenges.title: Smooth Layout Morphing Without DOM Repaint Jank
challenges.challenge: Combining dynamic expanders with nested modal overlays caused layout shifts on lower-spec mobile devices.
challenges.solution: Employed GPU-accelerated CSS transforms (`translate3d`, `scale`) coupled with Framer Motion `layoutId` tags and CSS will-change optimizations.

challenges.title: Accessible Keyboard Trapping in Custom Dialogs
challenges.challenge: Ensuring tab focus stayed constrained within animated overlays without interfering with background page focus.
challenges.solution: Integrated Radix UI focus-trap primitives wrapped inside Framer Motion AnimatePresence boundaries.
